description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Secureframe is hiring a new-grad software engineer to build product features for its security and compliance platform. The role involves collaborating across Product, Design, and Engineering, contributing to technical planning and code reviews, and growing with mentorship from senior engineers.
New Grad Software Engineer building product features with senior engineers and contributing to code reviews and planning

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate with Product Management, Design, and other stakeholders within Engineering to maintain a high bar for quality in a fast-paced, iterative environment
• Wear a product manager hat when needed
• Work with senior engineers to build features, learning how to solve technical problems of growing scope and complexity
• Use AI tools to move faster, while bringing the judgment to check their output
• Participate in planning activities, give and receive code reviews, and contribute to a growing team

Requirements:
• You understand that hard work and grit are critical to learning and growth
• You care about product ownership and solving problems for our customers
• You're passionate about being in a product-focused environment where everyone cares deeply about customer impact
• You care about your craft, and are looking to continually improve
• Experience with HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and a modern backend language, through school, internships, or personal projects
• Strong understanding of CS fundamentals
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or a related field, completed by summer 2027, or equivalent practical experience
• Passion and ability to work well in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
• Available to start full time between January and August 2027

Preferred:
• Exposure to Rails, PostgreSQL, or Elasticsearch
• Internship experience, or experience as a founder or at an early-stage startup
• Side projects or something you built and shipped
• Experience building with LLMs or AI tools
